generation.scope: Every ordinary rank-fifteen window in characteristic zero with positive valuation of x above 3 is standard Koszul and left/right AS-regular, free of rank 256 per start for every nonzero geometric y. In particular every rational ordinary pair with 3-integral x and nonzero rational y is regular. Entire verticals reducing to 0 have the stated conic classification, with the two split fibers x=3,3/4 and their period-one nodes. The xbar=-1 signed unit-residue cover is Galois of degree 384, genus 97, branched at 0, 1 and infinity.

proof_review.scope: Checked the rationalization of both boundary square roots and the two-parameter comparison, the conic classification on all xbar=0 fibers, the two period-one exceptions, and the ten inertia points and all six lifted transformations of the new unit cover.

mathematical_computation.scope: Computed the generic s=0 boundary to 15 exact digits and the 45-digit diagonal r=t,s=t^2. Compared the 308 complete ordered pivot lists and the central coordinate frames.

open_mathematics: On the rank-fifteen plane move to unit y with xbar=-1 and arbitrary residue y, beyond the prime-field grid. Put v=1/K and choose i^2=-1; then H=i(K-v), ybar=-(v-v^3)^2, and the signed radicands factor into products of v, 1+v, 1-v and 1 +/- i(1 +/- v). The six independent Kummer classes and the full degree-384 genus-97 cover are established. Compute the four central cuts and descend a pivot divisor over this cover, exploiting sign symmetries or a smaller quotient if possible. The unit levels with ybar=1 or -1 are already certified. Also treat nu(x)<0 outside the previously certified pole cone nu(y)<2nu(x) and the unrestricted nonsymmetric branches.
